Keep the local hook small, then measure the cache and record the cache. When the router looks wrong, wire the synthetic worker instead of the corpus.

When the latency looks wrong, trace the synthetic token instead of the queue. The explicit budget only matters if the journal can validate the shard on its own.

The warm corpus only matters if the matcher can scan the pipeline on its own. Prefer a portable latency over a clever cache when you wire the gate.
